# opnsense_nginx_sni_hostname_map (Resource)

nginx SNI upstream maps (**Services ▸ Nginx ▸ Configuration ▸ Streams ▸ SNI Based Routing**, plugin `os-nginx`): send TLS streams to an upstream chosen by the requested host name, without terminating TLS.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opnsense_nginx_sni_hostname_map" "tls" {
  description = "TLS passthrough"
  entries = [
    { hostname = "app.example.com", upstream = opnsense_nginx_upstream.app.id },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (String) Name of the map, shown in the drop-downs.
- `entries` (Attributes List) Host names and the upstreams they go to. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entries))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the map.

<a id="nestedatt--entries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entries`

Required:

- `hostname` (String) Host name sent by the client (SNI).
- `upstream` (String) UUID of an `opnsense_nginx_upstream`.
